|game_text=When deployed, you may not initiate battle here this turn. While at opponent’s site, adds one [Light Side Force] and one [Dark Side Force]. May ‘swing’ lightsabers for free. May never be won in sabacc. Immune to attrition < 5. End of your turn: ★ Use 1 or ⚑ Lose 1 or ☠.

|notes=[[Jedi Survivor (V) (Virtual Set 16: Revenge Of The Sith) (Preview July 2008)|The 26 July preview]] contains earlier exact publisher wording. The July preview bars the character from participating in battle on her deployment turn. The issued card instead limits your initiation of battle at her deployment site. The preview’s qualifying Jedi Lightsaber deploys and fires for free, and the preview gives Sniper immunity. The issued text makes lightsaber swings free and protects the character from being won in sabacc. Opponent-site Force icons, attrition immunity and three printed end-of-turn options carry forward. The spoiler names Droid Merchant as the backing. The surviving issuer face and sleeve margin each print three dots. Both sources give the same power, ability, destiny, deploy, forfeit, Warrior marker and character classification.
